svg.aria-label: Trigeminal nerve (CN V): three divisions and their skin territories — 三叉神经（CN V）：三个分支及其皮肤分布

text.aria-label: Trigeminal nerve (CN V): three divisions and their skin territories — 三叉神经（CN V）：三个分支及其皮肤分布
text.tspan: Trigeminal nerve (CN V): three divisions and their skin territories
三叉神经（CN V）：三个分支及其皮肤分布

text.aria-label: Skin territories, right lateral view — 皮肤分布区，右侧面观
text.tspan: Skin territories, right lateral view
皮肤分布区，右侧面观

text.aria-label: V1 Ophthalmic nerve: forehead and scalp to the vertex, upper eyelid, cornea, bridge and tip of the nose — V1 眼神经：前额和头皮至头顶、上睑、角膜、鼻背和鼻尖
text.tspan: V1 Ophthalmic nerve: forehead and scalp to the vertex, upper eyelid, cornea, bridge and tip of the nose
V1 眼神经：前额和头皮至头顶、上睑、角膜、鼻背和鼻尖

text.aria-label: V2 Maxillary nerve: lower eyelid, side of the nose, cheek, upper lip — V2 上颌神经：下睑、鼻侧、面颊、上唇
text.tspan: V2 Maxillary nerve: lower eyelid, side of the nose, cheek, upper lip
V2 上颌神经：下睑、鼻侧、面颊、上唇

text.aria-label: V3 Mandibular nerve: lower lip, chin, lower jaw, the area in front of the ear and the temple — V3 下颌神经：下唇、颏部、下颌、耳前区和颞部
text.tspan: V3 Mandibular nerve: lower lip, chin, lower jaw, the area in front of the ear and the temple
V3 下颌神经：下唇、颏部、下颌、耳前区和颞部

text.aria-label: Skin over the angle of the mandible: C2–C3 (cervical plexus), not CN V — 下颌角表面的皮肤：C2–C3（颈丛），不是 CN V
text.tspan: Skin over the angle of the mandible: C2–C3 (cervical plexus), not CN V
下颌角表面的皮肤：C2–C3（颈丛），不是 CN V

text.aria-label: The nerve and its three exits from the skull — 神经和三个出颅位置
text.tspan: The nerve and its three exits from the skull
神经和三个出颅位置

text.aria-label: Sensory root and motor root, from the pons — 感觉根和运动根，自脑桥发出
text.tspan: Sensory root and motor root, from the pons
感觉根和运动根，自脑桥发出

text.aria-label: Trigeminal ganglion (in the trigeminal cave) — 三叉神经节（位于三叉神经腔）
text.tspan: Trigeminal ganglion (in the trigeminal cave)
三叉神经节（位于三叉神经腔）

text.aria-label: V1: superior orbital fissure, to the orbit and forehead — V1：经眶上裂，至眶和前额
text.tspan: V1: superior orbital fissure, to the orbit and forehead
V1：经眶上裂，至眶和前额

text.aria-label: V3: foramen ovale, to the infratemporal fossa; the motor root joins it — V3：经卵圆孔至颞下窝；运动根加入其中
text.tspan: V3: foramen ovale, to the infratemporal fossa; the motor root joins it
V3：经卵圆孔至颞下窝；运动根加入其中

text.aria-label: V2: foramen rotundum, to the cheek and upper teeth — V2：经圆孔，至面颊和上牙
text.tspan: V2: foramen rotundum, to the cheek and upper teeth
V2：经圆孔，至面颊和上牙

text.aria-label: The mnemonic for the three exits is "Standing Room Only": Superior orbital fissure, foramen Rotundum, foramen Ovale. — 三个出颅位置的英文口诀是 Standing Room Only：眶上裂、圆孔、卵圆孔。
text.tspan: The mnemonic for the three exits is "Standing Room Only": Superior orbital fissure, foramen Rotundum, foramen Ovale.
三个出颅位置的英文口诀是 Standing Room Only：眶上裂、圆孔、卵圆孔。

text.aria-label: V1 and V2 are purely sensory; V3 is mixed because the motor root joins only V3. — V1、V2 是纯感觉神经；运动根只加入 V3，所以 V3 是混合神经。
text.tspan: V1 and V2 are purely sensory; V3 is mixed because the motor root joins only V3.
V1、V2 是纯感觉神经；运动根只加入 V3，所以 V3 是混合神经。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
